identity.title: [v0.92.1][V3-H.2] Implement v3 local lifecycle command routes

values.goal: Implement and test the v3 local lifecycle replacement routes under the one csdlc binary, using #627's command manifest as the denominator.
values.required_outcome: The v3 one-binary local routes can initialize, inspect, validate, edit, diagnose, and bind local lifecycle state for a real issue canary without v2 operational fallback, while remaining non-authoritative before #505 cutover.
authority_boundary: C-SDLC v2 remains live operational authority until explicit #505 cutover.
Issue #628 may implement local v3 construction-state behavior only.
Issue #628 must not mutate GitHub, publish PRs, finish, clean, retire v2, or close #505.
No hidden v2 binary fallback is allowed in v3 proof.
operator_constraints: Do not use /private/tmp; keep temporary and durable artifacts inside the repo or FastWork worktrees.
